name: Shiva psi session: chirp, counter-clockwise, 10->20 ms per coil (Murphy)
origin: Todd Murphy (his description of the psi signal and timing of Persinger's circumcerebral 'Octopus' and his Shiva replica); ring placement after the Persinger-lab Octopus
summary: Murphy's psi configuration for his Shiva system: a chirp signal rotating counter-clockwise around an eight-coil ring, with the time over each coil growing 10, 12 ... 20 ms and then starting again (about 8 turns a second), for 30 min. The vendor describes it for psychic skills; this is his claim only. It is not the session Persinger's lab gave Ingo Swann, which persinger-swann-2002-table1 runs.
notes: Murphy's lecture lists dwell steps ending in '14..16.. 18..20.. with the length of time over each area increasing as it goes along' (Psychic Skills lecture, 19:51-19:58). His Shiva overview page gives the rotation as 'usually around 9 times per second'. The page 'Shiva coil locations' says 'there are no coils above the nose', 'none above the bony ridge at the back of the head' and none 'directly above the ears'. This program lets the dwell grow 10, 12 ... 20 ms and start again. With six values on eight coils the ramp restarts every six steps and moves round the ring; neither this nor a restart at the first coil is documented. One turn takes about 0.12 s (8.3 turns a second). The sites Fp1, FT7, TP7, O1, O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2 are this project's reading of the locations page. The vendor's chirp file is not published: a sweep falling from 40 to 6 Hz on 3-ms points, 2.5 s on and 1.5 s off, stands in. The cited Shiva pages give no field strength; 1 uT is this project's choice. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The Persinger-lab session for Swann was different: six 5-min burst-firing and Thomas configurations with 20, 100 and 200 ms on the first coil, at 2 to 5 uT (Persinger et al. 2002 p.4 [930]). Murphy writes that 'the final phase ... was the one in which he experienced a clear remote viewing'; in the paper that is Swann seeing the three experimenters outside the chamber 'as skeletons' (p.8 [934]), not a blind trial. The paper does not test whether the fields changed accuracy. A vendor claim with no independent replication. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Do not use results for decisions about real people, places or money. Not for people with epilepsy; stop on distress.
setting: Blindfolded, seated or reclined in a quiet room. For perception during the session Murphy advises geomagnetic quiet (K 0-2); for skill training, run it at K 4 and practise a few days later. Swann's later trials used 4-6 hidden targets per session with about 2-3 min of drawing each.
schedule: At most once a week (Murphy, Staying safe with Shiva: 'Don't do sessions more often than once a week').
